project.name: Login
project.description: Login sources, module and standalone queries, formatting, validation, native templates, a transformation graph with source provenance and an interactive light-DOM view.

entries.name: Format Login (pretty)
entries.description: Format saved data/login.cem with the native pretty profile. Plain output is available for copy/download; formatting does not overwrite the source.

entries.name: Format Login (tabular)
entries.description: Format saved data/login.cem with the native tabular profile. Plain output is available for copy/download; formatting does not overwrite the source.

entries.name: Export Login source colors (HTML)
entries.description: Export the saved Login source as escaped, colored HTML. Copy/download preserves the native source colors; the sandboxed Studio preview blocks styles.

entries.name: Validate form method
entries.description: Validate the form method using the project-owned teaching schema.

entries.name: Login semantics from HTML
entries.description: Run the shared 21-field Login contract and compare with expected/semantics.json. Source wrappers and HTML mirrors are mapped explicitly by the query.

entries.name: Login semantics from CEM-ML
entries.description: Run the shared 21-field Login contract and compare with expected/semantics.json. Source wrappers and HTML mirrors are mapped explicitly by the query.

entries.name: Login semantics from HTML (CEM-QL)
entries.description: Run the equivalent CEM-QL module against the same 21-field contract. Consume ready namespace names explicitly with a bounded navigation budget; source declarations remain inert.

entries.name: Login semantics from CEM-ML (CEM-QL)
entries.description: Run the equivalent CEM-QL module against the same 21-field contract. Consume ready namespace names explicitly with a bounded navigation budget; source declarations remain inert.

entries.name: Render Login from HTML
entries.description: Generate an HTML Login form from the saved source. Edit the template instruction or a source field, save, and rerun.

entries.name: Render Login from CEM-ML
entries.description: Generate an HTML Login form from the saved source. Edit the template instruction or a source field, save, and rerun.

entries.name: Render Login graph
entries.description: Run the saved import → view template → HTML export graph. Edit a graph attribute, save, rerun and follow generated-output provenance to its template.

entries.name: Login live view
entries.description: Parse the saved element-template source with its registered runtime bindings, then preview it through shared light-DOM components. Open-content attribute warnings remain advisory.

entries.name: Evaluate Login expression (HTML)
entries.description: Evaluate saved queries/summary.cem-ql against this saved Login source. Compare title and required-field count with expected/expression.json; edit the expression through Resources.

entries.name: Evaluate Login expression (CEM-ML)
entries.description: Evaluate saved queries/summary.cem-ql against this saved Login source. Compare title and required-field count with expected/expression.json; edit the expression through Resources.

entries.name: Format Login expression (pretty)
entries.description: Format saved queries/summary.cem-ql without evaluating it or adding a module. Plain output is available for copy/download and never overwrites the source.

entries.name: Format Login expression (tabular)
entries.description: Format saved queries/summary.cem-ql without evaluating it or adding a module. Plain output is available for copy/download and never overwrites the source.
